what: Home Jetson Ethernet link responds; OS and USB access not yet established
why: There is no microSD available, so the next installation route must follow actual device and firmware evidence.
details: Direct Mac Ethernet link negotiates gigabit and one IPv6 peer answers; SSH and standard web-port probes time out. USB registry exposes no NVIDIA recovery/device-mode function, and there is no USB serial port or USB network interface. A separate 16 GB SanDisk stick contains an Intel Ubuntu 18.04.1 installer, not Jetson media. NVIDIA documents a Mac-created JetPack 7.2.1 USB installer to NVMe only after compatible JetPack 6-generation firmware is confirmed. Awaiting KVM/display firmware evidence; no storage, firmware or network settings changed.
